description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for handling firmware upgrades on LoongArch64-based systems, including image verification, partition management, copying EFI system partitions, and executing the upgrade process.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the partition layout of an upgrade image by comparing partition maps and optionally aborts if layout has changed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a designated partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates the EFI system partition with EFI boot files from a new image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the full system upgrade, including partition management, image installation, and EFI updates.
